subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Before the singing contest, Anna caught a cold and lost her voice.”?
options: Anna looked carefully and saw a small blue flower on one end.
Anna did not sing, but she had helped the show succeed.
Owen said, "Someone helped me last year when I forgot mine."
Saying a name correctly is one simple way to show respect.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Anna looked carefully and saw a small blue flower on one end.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Anna did not sing, but she had helped the show succeed.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Owen said, 'Someone helped me last year when I forgot mine.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
